glossary.ja: バロン・マクシミリアン
glossary.role: Masked figure who seizes control of Orphan in Jonathan's name and gives him the Baronz; secretly Anoa McCormick, the missing captain of Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Mysterious, theatrical and manipulative. Acts as a mentor to Jonathan, driven by a twisted longing for her estranged son.

glossary.role: Drake Luft's flagship aura battleship; an enemy ship in Operation 25.
Evolved Antibody created by reviving a Grand Cher (e.g. Jonathan Baronz, Quincy Baronz).
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
Reclaimer ace of Orphan; pilots Jonathan Grand Cher, later Jonathan Baronz; Yuu's rival and the son of Novis Noah's captain Anoa McCormick
glossary.personality: Arrogant, aggressive and taunting, full of resentment toward Yuu and his own mother. Loyal to Baron Maximilian.

glossary.role: Brain Powerd term for an Antibody being 'born' from an Orphan plate.
Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.role: Male lead; former Reclaimer who escapes Orphan and pilots Yuu Brain, later Nelly Brain, for Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Brooding lone wolf who resents his scientist parents. Often acts alone, but values life and comes to fight to save his sister Quincy.

glossary.role: Masked figure who seizes control of Orphan in Jonathan's name and gives him the Baronz; secretly Anoa McCormick, the missing captain of Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Mysterious, theatrical and manipulative. Acts as a mentor to Jonathan, driven by a twisted longing for her estranged son.

glossary.role: Short for Brain Powerd units (ブレンたち, ブレンパワード隊).
Female lead; 17-year-old Brain Powerd pilot (Hime Brain) aboard the Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Cheerful, warm and motherly toward the children and her Brain. Optimistic and brave, and believes in talking to people and Antibodies alike.

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op25_05. Covers Queen Ciela's tactical briefing, the climactic Phase 4 battle against Baron Maximilian in Baron Zu revealing her identity as Jonathan's mother willing to bear all sins for him, the visions inside Orphan, Irene Carrier and Queen Ciela's Phase 5 tactical briefings, and the start of the final Phase 5 fleet clash against Drake's Will Wips.
